senses.gloss: (b. h. שָׂפק)to divide, distribute; to supply;to suffice. Mekh. B’shall., Vayass‘a, s. 1 ולא סָפְקוּ אלא וכ׳ and they supplied water for only seventy date trees; כיון … וספקו להם ושנו וכ׳ when the Israelites came and six hundred thousand men encamped around them, they supplied them (with drinking water), and this a second and a third time.
to supply, furnish. Ib. s. 6 אם מְסַפֵּק לנו צרכנו וכ׳ (ed. Weiss מַסְפִּיק, Hif.) if he supplies our wants, we shall serve him &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:1">B. Mets. IX, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 103b:1">103ᵇ</cite>) <he>שניהם מְסַפְּקִין את הקנים</he> the two together have to furnish the needed poles.

<cite ref="Sotah 11b:18">Sot. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>היו מְסַפְּקוֹת להם מים ומזון</he> they supplied them with water and food; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII</cite> <he>לספק לו</he>, v. <cite ref="O01368"><he>סְפִיקוּלָא</he> I</cite>.]—V. <cite ref="O00789"><he>סִיפּוּק</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 4">Lev. R. s. 4</cite> (ref. to <he>יספוק</he>, <cite ref="Job 34:37">Job XXXIV, 37</cite>) <he>אתה מַסְפִּיק בנינו וכ׳</he> thou distributest thy sins among us, i.e. we have to suffer for thy sins; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 920">Yalk. Job 920</cite> <he>משתיק</he> (corr. acc.; Var. <he>משְׂפִּיק</he>). Mekh. l. c., v. supra; a. e.

senses.gloss: (with ביד) to give sufficient time or power; to allow an opportunity.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:18">Ab. V, 18</cite> <he>אין מַסְפִּיקִין בידו וכ׳</he> no time (or opportunity) will be given him to do repentance; <cite ref="Yoma 87a">Yoma 87ᵃ</cite>; Tosef. ib. V (IV), 11. Ib. 10 <he>אין מספיקין בידו וכ׳</he> he will be given no opportunity (temptation) to sin; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to have sufficient time, power &c.; to succeed, finish.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 21a:9">Taan. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>לא הִסְפַּקְתִּי לפרוק וכ׳</he> I had not yet finished unloading when &c. Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ bot. <he>לא ה׳ לומר עד וכ׳</he> he had not yet finished saying Sh’m‘a, when he expired; a. fr.—[Ib. 14ᵃ <he>מספיק למדינה</he>, v. <cite ref="O01342"><he>סָפַח</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to be supplied, to supply one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 8a:10">Pes. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>במִסְתַּפֵּק</he> when it is a store-room from which supplies are taken for the table; <cite ref="Pesachim 8b">ib. 8ᵇ</cite>. Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ bot. <he>אבותיכם היו מִסְתַּפְּקִין משלנו וכ׳</he> (not <he>בשלנו</he>) your fathers used to buy supplies (of wine) of our fathers, why do you not buy of us? Y. Dem. III, 23ᶜ, a. e. <he>מִסְתַּפֶּקֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="O00584"><he>סִידְקִי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 88a:20">Erub. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>אדם עשוי להִסְתַּפֵּק סאתים וכ׳</he> a person usually consumes two S’ah of water a day (from the supply in the cistern &c.); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Rabbah 7:2">Der. Er. ch. VII</cite> <he>ונִסְתַּפְּקוּ</he> they ate and were amply supplied (enjoyed their meal).

senses.gloss: (cmp. סָפֵק) to be doubtful Y. Yeb. XI, end, 12ᵇ נ׳ לו he was in doubt.
